**Correction applied:**

I moved the door to x=[6.013, 6.932] (same 0.92m width, now anchored at the jog corner/wall-2 west end), preserving width/height/IDs and space adjacency.

- Wall thickness/offsets were not surveyed via `check_wall_dimensions` (no wall_references saved).
- I did not have time (budget ran out before the 75s check reserve) to register an `overlay_candidate` calibration or re-run `check_openings` with a review_json against this specific corrected door — this correction is evidenced by direct pixel/crop inspection but not cross-checked via the overlay tool.

- General drawing fidelity remains `not_evaluated` per the delivery record; calibration is not independently verified.

Given the time constraint, I prioritized saving one well-evidenced, high-confidence correction (the mislocated door) over further speculative east-side changes, since the two east partitions I checked against the dimension chain already matched the seed closely.
